cumulative.notes: US Operation Epic Fury + Israeli Operation Roaring Lion. As of Mar 18 (CENTCOM via LWJ Mar 17-18): 7,800+ US strike targets, 8,000+ combat sorties, 120+ Iranian vessels out of action. Israeli: 7,600+ strikes in 13 days by Mar 13 (LWJ). As of Mar 24: ~4,500 killed using IDF estimate of 4,000-5,000 Iranian military/security killed as of Mar 13 (midpoint); civilian figure ~1,500 per Iran Health Ministry/Al Jazeera tracker. 18,551+ injured (Al Jazeera). Verified leadership kills: Ali Larijani/SNSC (IDF Mar 17), Gholamreza Soleimani/Basij commander (IDF Mar 17), Ghassem Ghoreyshi/Basij deputy (Iran International Mar 17), Mohammad Khatib/Intelligence Minister (IDF Mar 18).

daily.label: 28 Feb
daily.events: Operation Epic Fury begins. Khamenei assassinated. ~900 strikes in first 12 hours targeting IRGC, air defenses, drone sites, airfields, missile sites, naval facilities, nuclear facilities.

daily.label: 1 Mar
daily.events: Most intense day. B-2 stealth bombers strike hardened missile facilities. ~160 killed at girls' school in Minab (near naval base). Chief of Staff Mousavi and former president Ahmadinejad killed.

daily.label: 2 Mar
daily.events: IRGC Malek-Ashtar building in Tehran destroyed. Hezbollah enters conflict. Iran death toll reaches 555.

daily.label: 3 Mar
daily.events: IRIB (state broadcaster) in Tehran struck. Assembly of Experts gathering in Qom struck by Israeli Air Force. IAEA confirms damage at Natanz nuclear facility. ~4,000 targets struck total.

daily.label: 4 Mar
daily.events: Israel at 1,600 strike sorties. Iran death toll surpasses 1,000. ~2,100 military personnel estimated killed.

daily.label: 5 Mar
daily.events: Iran's president apologizes to neighbors, announces ceasefire toward Gulf states unless attacks originate from their territory.

daily.label: 6 Mar
daily.events: Israeli Air Force strikes 400+ targets, drops ~1,465 munitions on regime military sites. Tehran pounded.

daily.label: 7 Mar
daily.events: Continued strikes on military infrastructure across western and central Iran.

daily.label: 8 Mar
daily.events: Israel strikes Iranian oil facilities for first time: Aghdasieh oil warehouse, Tehran refinery, Shahran oil depot, Karaj oil depot. Toxic smoke blankets Tehran. Mojtaba Khamenei named new Supreme Leader.

daily.label: 9 Mar
daily.events: Continued strikes on IRGC missile storage sites in western Iran. Mojtaba Khamenei calls for ceasefire negotiations. US strikes Bandar Abbas port facilities.

daily.label: 10 Mar
daily.events: Reduced tempo as diplomatic channels open. Israeli strikes focus on remaining air defense radars. Iran's acting FM requests UN Security Council emergency session.

daily.label: 11 Mar
daily.events: Continued US/Israeli strikes. LWJ reports US has hit 5,500+ targets total. Iran ballistic launch rate dropped 92% (480→40/day). Drone launch rate dropped from 720→60/day.

daily.label: 12 Mar
daily.events: Dozens of airstrikes target Iran-backed militias across Iraq. 32 PMF HQ strikes since Feb 28 (LWJ). 10 security personnel killed in Tehran checkpoint attacks (Mar 11, per LWJ).

daily.label: 13 Mar
daily.events: Israel shifts to hyperlocal targeting — repression units and regime figures in Tehran. IDF assessment: 4,000-5,000 Iranian soldiers/commanders killed total. 5 Iranians arrested for filming strikes. Israel: 7,600+ total strikes in 13 days (LWJ). Source: LWJ.

daily.label: 14 Mar
daily.events: 15 killed in Isfahan industrial city strike (Al Jazeera Day 16). US/Israeli strikes continue targeting IRGC command nodes and security infrastructure. 20 arrested in NW Iran for alleged Israel cooperation. 10,000+ residential homes damaged/destroyed in Tehran. Sources: Al Jazeera Day 16, LWJ Mar 14-16.

daily.label: 15 Mar
daily.events: Cumulative: 1,400+ killed. Times of Israel reports 'signs of cracks' within Islamic Republic citing senior Israeli official; Israel 'facilitating conditions to empower Iranian people to overthrow the regime.' IRGC and Pezeshkian administration reportedly at odds over postwar outlook (IranWire/LWJ). Iranian police chief claims 500 arrested for sending info to 'the enemy.' 20 arrested in Urmia accused of being agents of 'Zionist regime.' Sources: Times of Israel, LWJ Mar 14-16.

daily.label: 16 Mar
daily.events: Cumulative: 1,444 killed, 18,551 injured (Al Jazeera Day 17). IDF precision strike on IRGC Navy HQ in eastern Tehran (responsible for disrupting international shipping and weapons transfers). IDF strike destroys facility linked to Iran's military space program in central Tehran (IRGC Chamran-1 satellite program). CENTCOM operational video update released. PM Netanyahu addresses Iranian people on Nowruz. Iran says missiles are 'from a decade ago'; newer production not yet deployed. Sources: IDF Persian account, CENTCOM, LWJ Mar 14-16.

daily.label: 17 Mar
daily.events: IDF kills Ali Larijani (Supreme National Security Council secretary), Basij commander Gholamreza Soleimani, and Basij deputy commander Ghassem Ghoreyshi (Iran International/LWJ). US CENTCOM strikes hardened coastal missile sites near Strait of Hormuz using 5,000-lb deep penetrator munitions (CENTCOM). Israeli strikes hit IRGC security units, Basij positions at 10+ Tehran locations, national police logistics center; ~300 Basij commanders/operatives killed cumulative (IDF). Israeli/US strikes destroy South Pars gas processing refineries 3, 4, 6 in Asaluyeh confirmed by Iran Passive Defense Organization (Axios/LWJ). 5 regime military personnel killed at missile-related site in western Iran (IDF). Sources: IDF statements, CENTCOM, LWJ Mar 17-18.

daily.label: 18 Mar
daily.events: IDF kills Mohammad Khatib, Iran's Minister of Intelligence ('played significant role in arrest and killing of protesters, led terrorist activities against Israelis and Americans worldwide' — IDF). CENTCOM: Operation Epic Fury surpasses 7,800 US strike targets, 8,000+ combat sorties, 120+ Iranian vessels out of action (CENTCOM statement via LWJ). Israeli operations Mar 17-18 hit 200+ regime-linked sites including ballistic missile storage, drone infrastructure, air defense systems, war production sites (IDF via LWJ). Kataib Hezbollah signals temporary pause in attacks on US Embassy in Baghdad (LWJ). Sources: IDF statements, CENTCOM, LWJ Mar 17-18.

daily.label: 19 Mar
daily.events: Iranian drones and missiles continue hitting regional energy infrastructure, airports, military bases, and US positions. Qatar: ballistic missile strikes Ras Laffan LNG hub, sparking fire (LWJ). UAE: Habshan gas facility and Bab oil field shut after attacks. Kuwait: drones strike Mina al Ahmadi and Mina al Abdullah refineries. SAMREF oil refinery in Yanbu, Saudi Arabia struck by drone. Iraq: US strikes continue against Iran-backed militias in Baghdad, Salah al Din, and Nineveh. Kataib Hezbollah formally announces temporary pause in US Embassy attacks (LWJ Mar 19). Sources: LWJ Mar 17-19, LWJ Mar 20 militia article.

daily.label: 20 Mar
daily.events: Iran and proxies continue attacking regional airports, energy facilities, military bases in Saudi Arabia, UAE, Kuwait, Bahrain, Iraq. Kuwait: two drones strike Mina al-Ahmadi refinery, fire contained. UAE: 4 ballistic missiles and 26 drones intercepted. Iraq: drones intercepted near Baghdad International Airport; drone strikes residential home in Erbil. Nowruz (Persian New Year) begins. Sources: LWJ Mar 20-23.

daily.label: 21 Mar
daily.events: Iran threatens Ras al Khaimah (UAE), issues evacuation warnings; UAE intercepts 3 ballistic missiles and 8 drones targeting RAK (LWJ). Iraq: three drones strike Abu Ghraib, wounding two; drone hits Iraqi National Intelligence Service HQ in Baghdad killing one officer. Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center targeted. Kuwait: 9 missiles intercepted. Sources: LWJ Mar 20-23.

daily.label: 22 Mar
daily.events: US strikes continue hitting Iran-backed Iraqi militias. Kataib Hezbollah declares temporary ceasefire on attacks targeting US Embassy in Baghdad; other militia groups vow to continue. UAE: 4 ballistic missiles and 25 drones intercepted. Iraq: overnight rocket/drone barrage on Baghdad Diplomatic Support Center — at least one rocket strikes Iraqi Counter-Terrorism HQ, injuring 5. Kurdish Peshmerga base in Makhmur struck by drone, 3 injured. Israeli forces kill Walid Dib (Hamas financier) plus two other Hamas members in Lebanon (Reuters/LWJ).

daily.label: 23 Mar
daily.events: Iran threatens to 'completely close' Strait of Hormuz if power plants struck. Bahrain: 36 drones and 2 missiles intercepted — largest single-day drone interception for Bahrain to date. UAE: 7 ballistic missiles and 16 drones intercepted. Iraq: 5 rockets from Iraq hit Kharab al Jir military base in NE Syria. Iran fires IRGC missiles at Tel Aviv area — confirmed casualties (Al Jazeera). Iran denies launching long-range missiles at Diego Garcia US/UK base, calls it 'false flag attack' (Al Jazeera). Sources: LWJ Mar 20-23, Al Jazeera.

daily.label: 24 Mar
daily.events: Day 25 of war. Trump claims peace negotiations ongoing with Iran; Tehran denies, IRGC calls Trump 'deceitful American president.' Huge explosions heard in Tehran and other cities; US-Israeli strikes continue despite Trump's peace talk claims (Al Jazeera, Reuters). Iran appoints new security chief following Larijani's assassination. Cumulative casualties: ~1,500 killed in Iran (Iran Health Ministry/Al Jazeera tracker), at least 18 in Israel, 13 US soldiers, 21 killed in Gulf states. Sources: Al Jazeera, Reuters.
